name: Shimo-Igusa
tagline: Shinjuku in 27 minutes and Shibuya in 37 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Suginami City, where Seibu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 37 minutes to Otemachi, 27 minutes to Shinjuku, 37 minutes to Shibuya and 58 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 45.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 3.7 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 45.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 42.3 m to 46 m, a difference of 3.7 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 4 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: スーパーマーケット三徳

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 1 pharmacy. The nearest hospital is 成瀬医院, about 19 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 薄病院, about 21 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Seibu Shinjuku Line.
congestion: Seibu Shinjuku Line runs at 148% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 下落合→高田馬場, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 2LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Iogi is ahead on how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shimo-Igusa. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Shimo-Igusa.

neighbours.lead: Saginomiya is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is, but Shimo-Igusa is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Shimo-Igusa in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 3 minutes sooner than Shimo-Igusa.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Seibu Shinjuku Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the low side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
